column1: Mini-system for capturing changes across runs
Originally biotech mutation tracking but reusable anywhere
Shows before vs after state in a compact snapshot
Good for comparisons across time (trading, betting, etc.)
Keeps track of deltas, not full datasets
Helps identify reinforcing or destabilizing patterns
Can double as an audit tool
Integrates best into closed-loop feedback runs
Core to IBS memory — prevents re-inventing analysis
